epics.title: Delivery Plan Generation Fix
epics.jtbd: When managing task graphs, I want the delivery plan to be properly validated and saved in the correct directory, so that orchestration workflow can reliably execute it.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce task plan validation failures to 0%
requirements: R1: The JSON plan must be written to the .eneik directory and its sourceIndex validated against the payload.
R2: A verification command must be added to explicitly verify the sourceIndex validation.

slices.title: Fix missing delivery plan criteria
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to deliver exactly the missing validation and file path criteria, so that the task graph compliance checks pass.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task plan JSON, When it is saved, Then it is written to the .eneik directory rather than the docs directory.
Given the sourceIndex field, When validated, Then a schema validator strictly checks it against the payload instead of accepting a hardcoded literal.
Given the new validation, When the verification command runs, Then a test or script explicitly asserts the sourceIndex linkage.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce PR rejection rate from missing criteria to 0%

epics.title: Core Knowledge Base (Upload, Search, Download)
epics.jtbd: When managing epidemiological materials, I want to catalog and search them by specific attributes, so that our institute's knowledge is accessible to all employees.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase E2E test coverage of the API to 100%
requirements: R1: The E2E test must target a deployed backend API using a proper baseURL and hit the system API to download documents.
R2: The E2E test must perform and assert document upload and deletion by an admin user, and accurately reflect changes in the catalog.

slices.title: Implement missing E2E test criteria
slices.jtbd: When implementing the test for this epic, I want to deliver exactly the missing criteria against a deployed backend, so that data operations do not fail unexpectedly in production.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment pre-populated with sample 'Epidemiological Protocol' documents, When the E2E test downloads a document, Then it correctly hits the system API using a configured Playwright baseURL.
Given an admin user session, When the test executes, Then it uploads and deletes a document and strictly verifies that the catalog reflects these changes.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase E2E test coverage of the API to 100%
